bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'POSTGRES_CONTAINERS_BEGIN\n'
docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}}' | grep -Ei 'postgres|gaybbs|gateapp|createvdobot' | cut -c1-150
printf 'POSTGRES_CONTAINERS_END\n'
printf 'HOST_PSQL='; command -v psql || true
for cid in deploy-gaybbs-1 gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1; do
 echo "CONTAINER=$cid"
 docker inspect "$cid" --format 'RUNNING={{.State.Running}} NETWORKS={{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{$k}} {{end}}'
 docker exec "$cid" sh -c 'printf "PG_BIN="; command -v psql || true; printf "DB_ENV_KEYS="; env | cut -d= -f1 | grep -Ei "DATABASE|PGHOST|DB_HOST|DB_NAME|DB_USER|DB_PASSWORD_FILE" | sort | tr "\n" ","; echo; printf "PG_MODULE="; node -e "try {console.log(require.resolve(\"pg\"))}catch(e){console.log(\"UNAVAILABLE\")}"' || true
done
